title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Hedge
subtitle: 环境保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 环境保护（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：环境保护（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：environment　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 environment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my grandmother ① protected an environment that no farmer in the valley would have named, and she said the protecting was the whole of the winter. The ② environment, meaning the place itself and not the land, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an environment, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ environment in that valley had the same short hedge beside it, and the ④ environment at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the birds and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An environment, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandmother said the naming is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the environment was the whole of the study, meaning the surroundings and not the place. The ⑥ environment, meaning the surroundings and not any of that, is the only thing in a study that everybody depends on and nobody names; environment, he said, is either something you protect or the only word that means both a place and surroundings. He said the surroundings are the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ environment had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short hedge. The ⑧ environment of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one valley and fourteen winters of naming; environment, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ environment I remember is the one named in the report, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. An ⑩ environment, my mother said in 1988, is the only one that improves by being named; every environment, she said, is a set of surroundings that has agreed to look like a place. She said the surroundings were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 环境（指山谷里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 环境（指那一处本身，与土地相对）
C. 固定搭配：protect an environment 保护一处环境
D. n. 环境（指留给鸟类的那一处）
E. n. 环境（抽象总称，指一个山谷的生态之事）
F. n. 环境（指报告上写到、被标出的那一处）
G. n. 自然环境（指人人都依赖却无人命名的那样东西）
H. n. 环境；外界条件（抽象总称，指人人都依赖却无人命名的那种条件）

items.q: protected an environment that no farmer in the valley would have named
The environment, meaning the place itself and not the land
the environment at the far side
the environment was the whole of the study

answers.why: protect an environment 意为“保护一处环境”，1972 年祖母保护了一处山谷里没有一位农人肯命名的环境。
environment 意为“环境”，指那一处本身而不是土地，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
environment 意为“环境”，指山谷里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一道短短的树篱。
environment 意为“环境”，指留给鸟类的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
environment 意为“自然环境”，指人人都依赖却无人命名的那样东西，叔叔说这处自然环境就是那项研究的全部。
environment 意为“环境、外界条件”，指人人都依赖却无人命名的那种条件而不是那一处地方，是研究里人人都依赖、却无人命名的东西。
environment 意为“环境”，指报告上写到、被标出的那一处，到 1980 年这一处成了报告里的一行。
environment 意为“环境”，祖母一月写道，整件事的生态之事是一个山谷和十四个冬天的命名。
environment 意为“环境”，我记得的是报告上标出的那一处，1986 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一处。
environment 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，一处环境是唯一会因为被好好命名而变得更好的东西。
